description: Firefly jet creature, default look (artist 2026-09-26: 'the colors instead of that exact yellow should be more of a firefly glow type color'). The sheet's dark body + banding is kept (charcoal shell, darker rubber mask/straps, mid-grey metal rims), but every accent that was the sheet's amber is FIREFLY GLOW: a bioluminescent green-tinged yellow (lampyrid light peaks near 560 nm, hue ~75 deg). Glow tiers rise band < lens < side-port ring < abdomen tip < nozzle throat < flame licks < flame outer < flame core. Wings are smoke grey and see-through via 'alpha' (0-1, written to Col alpha = glTF COLOR_0.a; the smoke + flame materials are alphaMode BLEND): denser at the root where the smoke leaves the port, thinnest at the ragged edges. material.alpha multiplies every translucent region (one knob for 'more / less see-through').

shell.note: the jet-pack torso / abdomen body (dark charcoal)

band.note: the abdomen bands (chevron x2 + the low ring) and the pack band: soft firefly glow

pack.note: the jet-pack tank on the back

rail.note: the side rails joining each side's two thrusters

mask.note: the rubber face mask / bug head below the brim, and the neck

filter.note: the filter canister on the snout tip

port_glow.note: glowing inner wall of each side-thruster hole (the smoke comes out here)

port_hole.note: dark floor of the thruster hole

abdomen_tip.note: glowing ring at the abdomen tip (the nozzle top ring; the firefly lantern)

smoke_root.note: wing smoke where it leaves the port (denser). Artist 2026-09-26: 'make the wings smokier like heavier smoke' - darkened + raised from 74,76,81 / 0.62

flame_lick.note: the flame tip licks (cooler, more see-through)

flame_outer.note: exhaust flame, outer teardrop (translucent so the core reads through)

flame_core.note: exhaust flame inner hot core (top glow tier)
